verdict.rationale: Orrick has a dedicated Patents practice group page that documents prosecution work: its PTO-registered lawyers regularly help clients secure new patent rights. That page also cites a substantial contested-patent track record of 60+ trials and 155+ IPRs, which supports the defensible-position element. Missing for 10: explicit description of application drafting/filing workflow and portfolio-strategy services, named prosecution practitioners, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: Our PTO-registered lawyers regularly help clients secure new patent rights, often when the technology or business practice at stake is not well understood
more than 155 inter partes review proceedings
